title: Clofazimine inhibits small-cell lung cancer progression by modulating the kynurenine/aryl hydrocarbon receptor axis.
authors: Sharma, Gunjan; Abdullah, K M; Qais, Faizan Abul; Khan, Parvez; Cox, Jesse L; Sarwar, Tarique; Nasser, Mohd Wasim; Batra, Surinder K; Siddiqui, Jawed A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究氯法齐明通过调控犬尿氨酸/AhR轴抑制小细胞肺癌进展，虽涉及AhR蛋白与小分子配体结合的计算模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法聚焦，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Small cell lung cancer (SCLC) is one of the highly metastatic malignancies that contributes to  approximately 15 % of all lung cancers. Most SCLC patients (50-60 %) develop osteolytic bone metastases, significantly affecting their quality of life. Among several factors, environmental pollutant 2,3,7,8-Tetrachlorodibenzodioxin (TCDD) and kynurenine (Kyn), an endogenous ligand derived from tryptophan (Trp) metabolism, activate the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) and are responsible for SCLC progression and metastasis. Further, elevated AhR expression in bone cells intensifies bone resorption, making the Kyn/AhR axis a potential target for the bone metastatic propensity of SCLC. We first assessed the expression profile of AhR in human SCLC cell lines and found a significantly increased expression compared to normal lung cells. Additionally, we also evaluated the clinical significance of AhR expression in the patient samples of SCLC along with the relevance of the same in the Rb1(fl/fl); Trp53(fl/fl); Myc(LSL/LSL) (RPM) mouse model using immunohistochemistry and found the higher AhR expression in the patient samples and RPM mouse tumor tissues. Using computational simulations, we found that clofazimine (CLF) binds at the activator (Kyn) binding site by forming a stable complex with AhR. The CLF binding with AhR was favored by Van der Waals and hydrophobic forces, and the proteins retained their secondary structure. Furthermore, we found that Kyn treatment potentiates the migration and clonogenic ability of SCLC cell lines by activating Erk/Akt oncogenic signaling. Treatment with CLF reduces AhR expression, which inhibits Kyn-mediated proliferation of SCLC cells, induces apoptosis, and cell cycle arrest in the G2/M phase. Further, our examination indicates that Kyn treatment also promotes osteoblast-mediated osteoclast differentiation through RANKL. The treatment with CLF impedes RANKL expression and osteoclastogenesis, suggesting that CLF has the potential to be used as the therapeutic for SCLC patients having bone metastasis.
abstract_zh: 小细胞肺癌（SCLC）是一种高度转移性恶性肿瘤，约占所有肺癌的15%。大多数SCLC患者（50-60%）会发生溶骨性骨转移，显著影响其生活质量。在多种因素中，环境污染物2,3,7,8-四氯二苯并二噁英（TCDD）以及由色氨酸（Trp）代谢产生的内源性配体犬尿氨酸（Kyn）激活芳香烃受体（AhR），并参与SCLC的进展和转移。此外，骨细胞中AhR表达升高会加剧骨吸收，使Kyn/AhR轴成为SCLC骨转移倾向的潜在靶点。我们首先评估了人SCLC细胞系中AhR的表达谱，发现其表达较正常肺细胞显著增加。此外，我们还通过免疫组织化学方法评估了SCLC患者样本中AhR表达的临床意义，并在Rb1(fl/fl)；Trp53(fl/fl)；Myc(LSL/LSL)（RPM）小鼠模型中验证了其相关性，发现患者样本和RPM小鼠肿瘤组织中AhR表达均较高。通过计算模拟，我们发现氯法齐明（CLF）通过形成稳定的AhR复合物，结合在激活剂（Kyn）结合位点。CLF与AhR的结合由范德华力和疏水作用力驱动，且蛋白质保持其二级结构。进一步研究发现，Kyn处理通过激活Erk/Akt致癌信号通路，增强SCLC细胞系的迁移和克隆形成能力。CLF处理可降低AhR表达，从而抑制Kyn介导的SCLC细胞增殖，诱导细胞凋亡，并使细胞周期阻滞于G2/M期。此外，我们的检测表明，Kyn处理还通过RANKL促进成骨细胞介导的破骨细胞分化。CLF处理则抑制RANKL表达和破骨细胞生成，提示CLF有潜力作为伴有骨转移的SCLC患者的治疗药物。
